verdict.rationale: Firebase CLI (firebase-tools) supports scriptable deploys, emulator suite, and CI-style testing (import/export, local emulators, non-interactive commands), which are commonly used in CI pipelines, and the Emulator Suite explicitly supports headless integration testing/QA. However, there is no first-party documentation explicitly describing CI/CD pipeline integration, headless auth flows for CI, or GitHub Actions examples in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, headless authentication in automation contexts, and independent confirmation of full non-interactive CLI usage in production CI systems.
